reason: This capacitor forms a load/compensation network with R2/R3 at the output; for basic DC operation and small-signal gain of the differential stage it is not required. Removing it mainly affects frequency response (stability/bandwidth), not the core biasing or differential action.
impact_estimate: Low for DC/functionality; medium for AC stability/transient behavior (may oscillate or show peaking depending on the rest of the loop).

reason: R3 is an explicit output load to ground; many simulations include it only to model loading or provide a DC path. If the output is otherwise observed with a high-impedance probe/load, deleting R3 won’t change the amplifier’s internal operation, just the output operating point/loading.
impact_estimate: Low if output is high-impedance; medium if the intended load/current draw is important (output swing and bias point will shift).

reason: R2 provides a return path for the auxiliary node net44 used only by the RC branch (C0 to VOUT1); if C0 is removed, net44 becomes unused and R2 can be removed with no effect. Even with C0 present, R2 mainly shapes the output pole/zero rather than enabling core amplification.
impact_estimate: Very low if C0 is removed (essentially none); otherwise low-to-medium (changes frequency response).
